name: llama.cpp native MTP
canonical_description: Uses the target model’s multi-token-prediction path rather than a separate block-diffusion drafter.
mechanism: Uses the checkpoint's built-in multi-token-prediction head/path as the speculative drafter. Recorded llama.cpp lanes select it with --spec-type draft-mtp; some Qwen3.8-Flash-Next lanes use a shared MTP GGUF sidecar.
constraints: Requires an engine/runtime path and checkpoint or sidecar that supports native MTP drafting.
The recorded Strix Halo ROCm lane is branch/patch-specific; native MTP support is not guaranteed across every backend or runtime revision.
tradeoffs: MTP state buffers consume memory that would otherwise be available for KV/context.
Native MTP and DFlash2 are distinct drafter mechanisms; this packet does not establish which one is faster for a particular setup.
re_review_triggers: llama.cpp native MTP support changes in a relevant backend or branch.
The MTP head/sidecar checkpoint or loading path changes.
A setup claims MTP caused a performance or quality effect without a matching comparison object.

canonical_sources.locator: title, body, and comments for the Strix Halo ROCm MTP stack
